+1 to helping Greenbank here. Proposed operational approach (short summary):

- Option 1 (SLA amendment): Accept APAC-only, 4-hour P2 overnight for a fixed 21-day window. Require weekly incident summary and a named Greenbank escalation contact. Offer a 5% pro-rated credit on the monthly invoice for the amendment period.
- Option 2 (Dedicated carve-in): Temporarily route overnight APAC traffic to a reserved pool for Greenbank for the 3-week window. No SLA change, charge a small fixed premium to cover reserved capacity.

Escalation path (recommended for Option 1):
- First responder (overnight): APAC on-call engineer (we’ll staff)
- If no acknowledgement within 4 hours -> Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) as regional escalation
- If still unresolved -> Michael Grant (michael.grant@redwood.com) and Marissa Cole for executive escalation

Requirements: signed amendment (I can draft), weekly telemetry export, and a short-review call after the 21 days. I attached a draft amendment language I’d use to capture the exception and the credit.
